data.title: An information panel at the Šimunky hillfort in Dolná Mariková
data.excerpt: On Sunday 24 March 2013 the Hradiská civic association, together with the local branch of Matica slovenská in Dolná Mariková, put up an information panel beside the Slavic hillfort in the locality known as Šimunky. The panel stands outside the hillfort enclosure, and the man who discovered the site, Gašpar Zemančík, came to the unveiling.

children.text: , together with the local branch of Matica slovenská in Dolná Mariková and with financial support from the village of Dolná Mariková, put up an information panel beside the Slavic hillfort in the locality known as

We placed the panel outside the hillfort enclosure, so that we did not interfere in any way with the area of the archaeological site. It stands within the rest area built in the past by the hiking club in Dolná Mariková. From now on every visitor to this exceptional place, where our Slavic ancestors lived 1,000 years ago, can learn basic information about the hillfort, enjoy pictures of the finds made there, and also see what the hillfort may have looked like in the time of Great Moravia.

To our great delight, our invitation was also accepted by the discoverer of the hillfort, Mr Gašpar Zemančík, who in the past found a great many exceptional finds there together with the archaeologist Jozef Moravčík and with Štefan Meliš.

children.text: The panel was ceremonially unveiled by Čendo Žrec. We christened it symbolically – with Nitrianske knieža wine…
The Slavic gods granted us luxurious weather. We brought the enthusiasm and the good mood along with us, and truly, those who came certainly did not regret it.

We thank everyone who took part in this, our first project, for their selfless help, the owner of the land for his helpfulness and the mayor of Dolná Mariková for the financial support for the panel.
